description: Persistence collections for owner-scoped canonical transcripts, runs, tools, policies, opaque approval continuations, and durable call claims.

collections.name: canonical_transcripts
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_canonical_transcripts_order ON canonical_transcripts (ownerId, sessionId, sequence)
CREATE INDEX idx_canonical_transcripts_session ON canonical_transcripts (ownerId, sessionId, sequence)

collections.name: subpolar_runs
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_runs_owner_run ON subpolar_runs (ownerId, runId)

collections.name: subpolar_run_events
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_run_events_owner_event ON subpolar_run_events (ownerId, eventId)
CREATE INDEX idx_subpolar_run_events_run ON subpolar_run_events (ownerId, runId, occurredAt)

collections.name: subpolar_tool_definitions
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_tools_owner_tool ON subpolar_tool_definitions (ownerId, toolId)

collections.name: subpolar_tool_policies
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_policies_owner_policy ON subpolar_tool_policies (ownerId, policyId)

collections.name: subpolar_approval_continuations
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_continuations_owner_approval ON subpolar_approval_continuations (ownerId, approvalId)

collections.name: subpolar_call_claims
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_call_claims_owner_call ON subpolar_call_claims (ownerId, callId)
CREATE INDEX idx_subpolar_call_claims_state ON subpolar_call_claims (ownerId, state)

collections.name: subpolar_tool_audits
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_subpolar_audits_owner_audit ON subpolar_tool_audits (ownerId, auditId)
